baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic construction لَكَ لَأَجْرًا and the qualifier غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The work-return carried by أجر is assigned emphatically to the addressee, while غير negates the م ن ن image of an extension being cut or diminished. The promise therefore concerns both continuance and preservation from attrition.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work or contract supplies the payment register of أجر and makes the promise a return rather than generic praise.
Otherness, exception, and negation let غير exclude a destructive property from the promised return.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the event denied by غير, including interruption through exhaustion, time, or loss.

changed_reading.before: A reward is promised to the addressee.
changed_reading.after: An emphatically assigned return has an extension that no reduction, exhaustion, or terminating cut can consume.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same phrase أَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ, with غير able to negate the favor-accounting branch of م ن ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recompense can be spoiled relationally when a benefactor makes the recipient carry the favor through reminders and claims. On this branch, غير ممنون denies not only temporal interruption but also the conversion of giving into leverage.

activation_trace.role: The return for work supplies something genuinely given to the addressee rather than a bare compliment.
Negation makes the following favor-accounting image the excluded relation.
A weighty favor or its verbal rehearsal supplies the coercive burden that can ruin an otherwise good gift.

changed_reading.before: The reward is inexhaustible in quantity or time.
changed_reading.after: The reward is also unweaponized: it does not become a remembered favor by which the giver humiliates, invoices, or controls its recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three focus roots permit a repair sequence within أَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The form-distant break-knitting branch of أجر, the provisioning and repair branch of غير, and the sustaining-strength branch of م ن ن combine into a material reading: the return is an active repair whose supporting force does not fail. This is a branch-layer activation, not a replacement gloss for the syntax.

activation_trace.role: A break knitted after fracture turns the reward root toward repair, while its crooked healing keeps the image materially imperfect.
Benefit through provision, watering, and setting right supplies the ongoing restorative action.
Inner strength that sustains a thing, or its loss, supplies the capacity whose failure the negated qualifier resists.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an external payment delivered after work.
changed_reading.after: The reward can also be carried as continuing repair and inward load-bearing strength that keeps the worker from finally breaking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath couples a tool made by controlled cutting with ordered inscription immediately before the uncut recompense. The reward can therefore be heard as a due entered into a durable account: the reed is cut to write it, but the entitlement written is not itself severed.

activation_trace.role: Contract-like recompense supplies the due that can be entered or certified.
The denied cutting of an extension marks the recorded due as resistant to cancellation or attrition.
Cutting and paring a hard object to level it supplies the controlled cut by which the writing instrument is prepared.
The pared writing reed supplies the concrete instrument of inscription.
The ordered written line supplies the durable account into which the promised return is imaginatively placed.

structural_cues: The pen oath and what is inscribed stand only two ayahs before the focus promise.
The doubled emphasis in لَكَ لَأَجْرًا makes the promise sound already assigned rather than merely hoped for.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a pared writing instrument, ordered inscription, and an emphatically assigned work-return. Reader arrow: inscription functions as certification that protects the due from erasure. Live alternative: the pen oath may certify the message generally without making the reward an account entry.

changed_reading.before: The promise assures a future reward.
changed_reading.after: The reward sounds like an already inscribed claim whose validity is not cut off by hostile revision of the addressee's work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assured reward supplies a counter-economy to the proposed exchange of mutual accommodation. Because the addressee's return is secured elsewhere and carries sustaining strength, opponents cannot purchase obedience by offering reciprocal softness.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work supplies the alternative source of value that competes with social approval.
Undiminished sustaining strength supplies the present capacity to resist rather than only a later prize.
Submission and obedience identify the action the opponents seek and the prohibition blocks.
Soft conciliatory dealing supplies the reciprocal bargain: accommodate them and they will accommodate in return.

structural_cues: The reward promise precedes two commands not to obey the deniers.
The matched verbs تُدْهِنُ and يُدْهِنُونَ stage compromise as reciprocal exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: assured recompense, a ban on obedience, and a proposed exchange of soft accommodation. Reader arrow: secure recompense removes the opponents' economic and social leverage, so reward enables refusal now. Live alternative: the reward may only compensate refusal afterward and play no enabling role.

changed_reading.before: The reward compensates steadfastness after the ordeal.
changed_reading.after: Its assured availability also acts in the present, making integrity economically independent of the approval offered for compromise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages a severance loop. A withholding hand plans to harvest by cutting while excluding a needy recipient; the garden itself becomes cut off, and its owners name themselves deprived. Against that loop, غير ممنون is not merely long duration but a form of return that is not produced by severing provision from others.

activation_trace.role: Provision, watering, benefit, and repair give the promised non-cut return a materially distributive texture.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the exact destructive pattern the focus negates.
The hand withheld from giving supplies the social form of severance before the garden story materializes it.
Cutting palm fruit supplies the owners' planned harvest and their attempt to control its recipients.
Cutting and separation return as the condition of the garden itself, reversing the intended cut onto its planners.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired good name the terminal state generated by the severance economy.

structural_cues: The owners whisper that no needy person should enter the garden that day.
The sequence moves from intended harvest, to a garden like the cut-off, to the owners' confession that they are deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated harvest-cutting, deliberate exclusion, the garden's reversal, and confessed deprivation. Reader arrow: withholding benefit from a recipient rebounds as loss of the provision itself, so the focus reward is anti-severance in both time and social circulation. Live alternative: the garden may exemplify punishment for arrogance without specifying the economy of the addressee's reward.

changed_reading.before: The reward cannot be ended by time.
changed_reading.after: The reward belongs to an economy unlike the garden owners': its benefit is not secured by cutting others off, and its extension is not converted into deprivation through withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: After loss, the garden owners hope for something better to stand in place of what vanished. That substitution activates the change branch within غير and revises non-interruption: continuity of good need not mean preservation of one unchanged object; it can cross loss through a better replacement.

activation_trace.role: Altering a form or substituting one thing for another opens a dynamic rather than static sense of continuity.
The denied cut preserves the extension of benefaction even when its vehicle changes.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the explicit replacement mechanism after deprivation.

structural_cues: The hope is specifically for something better than the lost garden, not merely for restoration of the same object.
The request follows confession and renewed desire toward their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a cut-off garden, confession, and hope that a better thing will replace it. Reader arrow: replacement can carry continuity across rupture, so uncut reward need not be immobile sameness. Live alternative: the owners' hope may remain separate from the addressee's promised reward and may not be fulfilled.

changed_reading.before: An uncut reward is the same good continuing unchanged.
changed_reading.after: Its continuity may be resilient rather than static: benefaction can survive a lost form by arriving in a better substituted form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rhetorical refusal to make the sound/submitting and the criminal interchangeable activates غير as moral difference and أجر as a return set for work. The promised reward becomes an instance of judgment preserving distinctions, not arbitrary patronage that can be withdrawn on whim.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work supplies the result that a discriminating judgment assigns.
Otherness and difference supply the refusal to collapse contrary moral categories into one outcome.
A reward set upon an act turns the rhetorical making into a latent compensation decision.
Soundness and freedom from defect supply one side of the contrast whose outcome should not be erased.
Crime and culpable injury supply the contrary category in the non-equation.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative process that preserves the difference.

structural_cues: The focus promise is later followed by the explicit question whether those who submit are made like criminals.
Questions about judgment, a book, binding oaths, and guarantors turn the section into a hearing over entitlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a promised work-return, a rhetorical non-equation, and repeated questions about judgment and warrant. Reader arrow: the reward is one concrete way just judgment keeps unlike moral trajectories unlike. Live alternative: the questions may refute the opponents' expectations without supplying the juridical basis of the focus promise.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a personal favor bestowed on the addressee.
changed_reading.after: It is also a discriminating judgment that refuses to make faithful work interchangeable with culpable injury, and so is less vulnerable to arbitrary recall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those later summoned cannot perform what they had been summoned to do while sound. This converts the sustaining-strength branch of غير ممنون into preserved answerability: an uncut reward may include the continuing capacity to respond, not only an external good possessed after response.

activation_trace.role: Inner strength that sustains a thing, or its loss, supplies the capacity dimension of the promised non-failure.
Ability and capacity supply the faculty that is absent when response is finally demanded.
Former soundness and freedom from defect show that the lost capacity was once intact.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts a present inability to prostrate with an earlier call received while sound.
The same ط و ع cue spans obedience in 68:8 and ability in 68:42, binding moral response to capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a call, final inability, and prior soundness, alongside the focus branch of sustaining strength. Reader arrow: preserved capacity to answer is itself part of the reward's non-diminution. Live alternative: the inability scene may judge the opponents only, while the addressee's reward remains wholly external.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an endless benefit received for obedient action.
changed_reading.after: The reward may already include an undiminished capacity for answerable action, in contrast to soundness that is allowed to lapse into inability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents receive extended time while being taken degree by degree within a solidly extended strategy. Since duration can belong to an ominous process, غير ممنون cannot be reduced to mere length. Its continuity must remain a beneficial return rather than a long interval whose direction is ruin.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial recompense fixes the positive quality that duration alone cannot guarantee.
The uncut extension supplies the temporal baseline that the later ominous extension complicates.
Taking degree by degree supplies a continuous process whose apparent progress conceals its adverse direction.
Temporal extension and respite demonstrate that a long span can be granted without being a reward.
Extended solidity gives the adverse plan durable force and prevents simple duration from carrying a positive value.

structural_cues: The extension in 68:44-45 is explicitly attached to those denying the message, not to the rewarded addressee.
The sequence pairs unnoticed gradual movement with deliberate respite.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: uncut recompense on one side and extended, stepwise respite within a strong adverse strategy on the other. Reader arrow: the contrast disqualifies sheer duration as a sufficient definition of reward and requires beneficent direction. Live alternative: the two extensions may be unrelated and need not interpret one another.

changed_reading.before: غير ممنون means chiefly that the reward lasts a very long time.
changed_reading.after: Its uncutness is enduring good, not bare duration; the surah also contains a long extension that is precisely not reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rhetorical question repeats أجر but reverses its direction. In the focus, reward moves toward the addressee; in 68:46, charging the audience would leave them bound by financial liability and loaded down. The promised reward therefore supports a message that does not invoice its hearers.

activation_trace.role: The addressee's work-return supplies the incoming compensation whose source is at issue.
A favor made heavy by reminder supplies the relational burden excluded from the promised return.
The repeated work-wage image tests whether compensation is being extracted from the audience.
Binding financial liability supplies the debt that an audience-funded wage would impose.
Loading a heavy burden supplies the embodied effect of that liability on the hearers.

structural_cues: The same surface أجر appears in the focus promise and in the later rhetorical denial of a fee.
The focus fronting لَكَ directs reward toward the addressee, whereas 68:46 imagines a charge directed toward the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: incoming reward in 68:3 and a denied audience fee linked to liability and burden in 68:46. Reader arrow: compensation supplied from elsewhere releases the message from dependence on audience payment and releases hearers from debt. Live alternative: 68:46 may only rebut a specific accusation and need not characterize the inner quality of غير ممنون.

changed_reading.before: The giver does not use the reward to burden its recipient with favor-accounting.
changed_reading.after: The reward also makes the addressee non-extractive: because his compensation does not come from the audience, he need not bind hearers as debtors or make the message a load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning about the fish-companion places commanded endurance beside a near rupture that grace catches. A rope-splice branch, rescue from unsupported exposure, and subsequent restoration revise the reward's continuity: what remains uncut is the sustaining relation, not necessarily the worker's flawless linear performance.

activation_trace.role: A fracture knitted back together supplies the material image of continuity repaired after a break rather than never tested.
The denied severance identifies what the later catch and splice prevent from becoming final.
Sustaining inner strength, including its possible loss, allows continuity to include support during human depletion.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the demanded mode of endurance and the point at which failure is possible.
A splice or added link in a rope supplies the precise mechanism by which a threatened continuity is rejoined.
Good condition and benefaction supply the rescuing force that catches the endangered bearer.
Being left neglected and without support supplies the fate the catching benefaction prevents.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the restorative outcome after the near rupture.

structural_cues: The command to endure is immediately qualified by a counterexample who called out while constricted.
The sequence moves from nearly being cast out and blamed to being chosen and made among the sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: commanded endurance, a caught near-failure, rescue from unsupported exposure, and restored soundness. Reader arrow: the uncut element is the Lord's sustaining and rejoining action, which can bridge a bearer's rupture. Live alternative: the fish-companion may function only as a warning against impatience, leaving reward contingent on uninterrupted performance.

changed_reading.before: Uncut reward follows an unbroken line of successful endurance.
changed_reading.after: Its continuity can cross a worker's near-failure because benefaction catches, splices, and restores before rupture becomes abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah is framed by writing at the opening and a reminder for all worlds at the close. Work-return that is not cut can therefore extend through the continued circulation of what was inscribed and remembered, rather than being exhausted when the initial act of delivery ends.

activation_trace.role: Return for work supplies an outcome that can continue through the work's effects.
The non-severed extension lets the return persist beyond the first performance of the work.
The pared writing reed supplies material transmission beyond a single spoken occasion.
The ordered written line supplies durable repeatability of the work.
Reminder as that which makes one remember supplies the recurring effect that carries the return outward.

structural_cues: Writing in 68:1 and reminder for the worlds in 68:52 form an opening-to-closing transmission frame.
The personal لَكَ in the focus sits inside a surah whose final object has universal reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: written lines at the opening, personal work-return in the focus, and a world-directed reminder at the close. Reader arrow: the continuing effects of transmitted reminder participate in the worker's continuing return. Live alternative: the universal reach of the reminder and the addressee's reward may be parallel assurances with no causal link.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a private payment after a completed task.
changed_reading.after: Part of its uncut extension may lie in the work becoming a repeatable reminder whose benefit keeps circulating after the first delivery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the measured-weight branch of م ن ن is form-distant from the ordinary qualifier, but it remains packet-backed in the focus and is reactivated by the later burden/weight cue. Downstream prose should present it as a material accounting echo, not as the lexical translation of ممنون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غير negates ممنون directly after the work-return أجر, allowing a measured-weight branch to be denied.

activation_trace.role: Recompense supplies an accounting object that would ordinarily be quantified.
Negation excludes the following measurement image from the reward.
A named weight or measure supplies the finite quota that the qualifier can imaginatively refuse.
Measure and weight reactivate quantified obligation precisely where an audience fee would make people burdened.

changed_reading.before: The reward is not diminished or terminated.
changed_reading.after: The reward also resists rationing into a weighable quota, unlike obligations whose measurable weight can be loaded onto debtors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The unguarded-roof branch of أجر is highly remote from recompense, so this cannot serve as a translation. It remains worth carrying because the packet later supplies uncovered open ground and an explicit near-slip under hostile sight, while the focus supplies sustaining strength. Render it only as a spatial image of support under exposure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The أجر inventory includes an unguarded roof, and ممنون includes sustaining strength or its loss.

activation_trace.role: An exposed roof without a surrounding barrier supplies the precarious spatial platform.
Sustaining inner strength supplies traction that does not fail even without enclosure.
Open uncovered space extends the focus roof image into explicit exposure.
A thing slipping from its station on ground where no foot holds supplies the threatened loss of footing.
Literal eyesight supplies the hostile gaze under which the near-slip occurs.

changed_reading.before: Reward protects by enclosing the addressee from danger.
changed_reading.after: The strange spatial image is support without enclosure: stable footing can persist at an exposed edge even while hostile eyes nearly dislodge him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets غير negate the free-release branch of م ن ن, producing a due-versus-discretion contrast rather than the usual endlessness. It remains anchored by the focus work-return and the later opposition between أجر and financial liability. Downstream prose should call it a contractual resonance and keep it alongside, not instead of, the non-coercive gift reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر names work-return, while غير ممنون can formally exclude the branch of free release without compensation.

activation_trace.role: Work-return and contract-like exchange supply the status of a settled due.
Negation separates that due from the following discretionary-release image.
Free release without compensation supplies the discretionary act that this exploratory reading excludes.
The repeated wage image confirms that compensation and its direction remain a live issue later in the surah.
Binding financial liability distinguishes a settled return owed to the addressee from a debt imposed on the audience.

changed_reading.before: The reward is optional generosity that could remain at the patron's discretion.
changed_reading.after: On this branch it resonates as a settled return rather than revocable largesse, while still creating no financial liability for the audience.

strongest_changes: The garden's cut-withhold-deprivation reversal turns non-interruption into an anti-severance social economy, not merely endless time.
The ominously extended respite of 68:44-45 shows that duration alone is insufficient; the promised continuity must remain beneficent in direction and quality.
The repeated أجر in 68:46 reverses payment direction and makes the focus reward non-extractive: compensation reaches the addressee without loading the audience with debt.
The caught and restored fish-companion allows continuity to cross near-failure through rescue and repair rather than requiring flawless linear endurance.
summary.what_was_special: A seven-word assurance opened several coexisting mechanisms: durable inscription, resistance to compromise, distributive provision, discriminating judgment, preserved agency, non-extractive compensation, repair across rupture, and continued return through remembrance. The same branch field also sustained deliberately contained images of unmeasured provision, exposed footing, and a due that is not discretionary release.
remaining_uncertainties: The favor-reminder branch of م ن ن may be a genuine relational layer or only a secondary echo beside the stronger cutting-and-diminution branch.
Replacement after the garden and preserved capacity at the call may illuminate the focus mechanism without being direct specifications of the addressee's reward.
The measurement, unguarded-roof, and free-release outliers are packet-anchored but form-distant and should never be promoted into unqualified lexical glosses.
